summary.oneLiner: Allcargo Gati delivered flat revenue but improved gross and EBITDA margins through disciplined cost cuts and customer portfolio rebalancing; the imminent demerger of Supply Chain business into Gati is the key catalyst to unlock synergies and scale, transforming it into a full-service logistics player.

one-line thesis: Allcargo Gati delivered flat revenue but improved gross and EBITDA margins through disciplined cost cuts and customer portfolio rebalancing; the imminent demerger of Supply Chain business into Gati is the key catalyst to unlock synergies and scale, transforming it into a full-service logistics player.
financial scorecard: Revenue: -0.3% YoY (INR357cr vs INR358cr); EBITDA: -30% YoY (INR14cr vs INR20cr) but margin up 100bps to 4%; PAT: N/A (unaudited); order book: N/A; net debt: N/A - one-off: INR2cr reduction in doubtful debt provision, INR1cr lower customer deductions boosted EBITDA
guidance: Revenue growth: 8-10% YoY (above market); EBITDA margin: 6.5-7% for Express business by FY26 end; order inflow: N/A; capex/commissioning: N/A
segment / subsidiary detail: Express: 67% KEA, 19% Retail, 14% SME; volume flat YoY (299K MT vs 304K MT); realization up 2% YoY to INR11,961/tonne; Air Express: revenue down QoQ/YoY but dedicated team formed for growth; Supply Chain: to be merged into Gati by Sep 2025; MSME: flat volume but improving traction post July initiatives
growth verticals / optionality: Air Express (low base, 3-4% CAGR target); MSME segment (higher yield); cross-selling between Express and Supply Chain post-merger; Student Express and Bike Express niche services
margins & cost dynamics: Gross margin up 170bps to 25% YoY; EBITDA margin up 100bps to 4%; employee cost down 10% YoY (after increments); admin costs held flat despite 7-8% input inflation; cost efficiency via data-driven route optimization and partner performance tuning
capital allocation: Focus on debt reduction and demerger execution; proceeds from fuel station sale (expected Q2FY26) to be reinvested in logistics network; no dividend or buyback mentioned
risks & watch-items: Slow MSME volume recovery; delay in demerger approval beyond Sep 2025; air express growth lagging; competitive pricing pressure from larger players; monsoon disruption risk
management quality / tone: Confident and disciplined; focused on margin expansion over volume; optimistic on demerger timeline; proud of service quality (NPS improving) and new customer acquisition (+120% YoY); proactive on cost control
non-obvious takeaways: Despite flat volumes, new business additions grew 120% YoY — indicating strategic exit from low-margin customers; NPS improvement across 250+ customers (85-90% revenue) signals strong retention potential; student and bike logistics are niche differentiators with high margins
